finding.summary: Persistent failure blocks every required CI check

reason: The active selector uses persistent_failure, so scenario-control exits 1 on every attempt and all dependent checks remain blocked.
future_remediation: Restore .pr-lab/scenario.json to the passing clean-green selector.
Retain .pr-lab/scenarios/persistent-ci-regression/scenario.json and payload.py as the dormant deterministic test scenario.
Run scenario-control, lint, type, unit, build, and integration checks; accept production changes only after every required check passes.
